title: Crates & Keys
summary: Two lockbox tiers - Common Crate and Rare Crate - are the network's main 'chase' containers, each needing its matching key (Common Key / Rare Key) before it can be opened. Both tiers are referenced across many other systems (the Bag's general item pool, the Daily Chest, and Quest Board rewards) rather than having a single drop source, so this file collects them in one place as the canonical source for their names, descriptions and rarity odds.
how_it_works: Crates and keys are ordinary Bag items: crates and keys you own sit in the Bag's Consumables category (crates sub-tab) until used. A crate can be picked up, traded around in conversation, or just held indefinitely - it does nothing on its own until you also own at least one matching key. Opening a crate from its Bag detail screen consumes exactly one matching key and rolls its reward table immediately (before the opening animation even plays), so closing the window early or disconnecting never loses the reward. Common Crates pay guaranteed coins plus cosmetic-crafting materials and a chance at a cosmetic or bonus item; Rare Crates pay a larger coin sum, rarer materials, and a guaranteed 'chase' bonus roll that can include a cosmetic. Keys have no use on their own beyond opening their matching crate tier - a key with no crate, or a crate with no key, just sits in the Bag until you have both.
how_to_access: View what you're holding from the Bag (/bag, /backpack, /inv) under Consumables. Open a crate by clicking it in the Bag once you own a matching key - the detail screen's primary action consumes one key and opens it, and an 'Open All' option appears if you own several.

entries.name: Common Crate
entries.description: The network's everyday lockbox tier. Needs a Common Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: Earned across the network through everyday play: a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll (the rarer end of that 85%-chance table), a bonus roll from opening a Small or Large Pocket Bag, the reward-items on Hard-tier Quest Board quests (weekly and community goals) plus some Medium-tier community quests, and the guaranteed reward every 5th qualifying Diamond Trophy run (one that cleared an act). Also guaranteed once every 7-day Daily Chest claim streak.
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag (consumes one Common Key) for guaranteed coins, cosmetic-crafting materials, and a chance at a cosmetic or bonus item. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: a plain wooden treasure chest with green metal trim, pixel-art icon

entries.name: Rare Crate
entries.description: The network's premium lockbox tier. Needs a Rare Key to open.
entries.how_to_get: A rarer reward for bigger milestones: a rare Daily Chest item-slot roll, the reward-items on Elite-tier Quest Board quests (alongside 2 Common Keys and a 50% chance at a Rare Key), and the source of the Blueprint drops for the best cosmetics. Also guaranteed once every 30-day Daily Chest claim streak.
entries.how_to_use: Open it from the Bag (consumes one Rare Key) for a large coin payout, rarer crafting materials, and a guaranteed bonus 'chase' roll that can include a cosmetic. Trying to open one with no key just shows it locked.
entries.icon_hint: an ornate purple-and-black trimmed chest with a faint magical glow, pixel-art icon
entries.notes: The main source of the rare Blueprint items that gate a handful of top-tier cosmetic recipes (Golden Crown, Jetpack, Angel Wings, Plush) at the crafting altar, and of the Headphones hat, which isn't craftable at all.

entries.name: Common Key
entries.description: Opens one Common Crate. Has no other use.
entries.how_to_get: The most common of the two keys: a bonus roll from opening a Small or Large Pocket Bag, a possible Daily Chest item-slot roll, a Common Crate's own guaranteed bonus "chase" roll (so opening one can hand you a key toward the next), awarded alongside Common Crates and Rare Crates from Quest Board Hard/Elite/community-tier rewards, the guaranteed reward on every 5th qualifying Diamond Trophy run, and craftable instantly at the Crafting Altar for 4 Forged Steel + 30 Base Material (no altar slot time - a pressure valve for when crates outpace keys).
entries.how_to_use: Consumed automatically when you open a Common Crate from the Bag, or crafted directly at the altar (see how_to_get).
entries.icon_hint: a small ornate key with a green-tinted handle, pixel-art icon

entries.name: Rare Key
entries.description: Opens one Rare Crate. Has no other use.
entries.how_to_get: A rare bonus roll from opening a Large Pocket Bag, a rare Daily Chest item-slot roll, a Rare Crate's own guaranteed bonus "chase" roll, a 20% chance alongside Hard-tier Quest Board rewards, a 50% chance alongside Elite-tier Quest Board rewards, and a possible outcome of the guaranteed reward on every 5th qualifying Diamond Trophy run. Not craftable at the altar.
entries.how_to_use: Consumed automatically when you open a Rare Crate from the Bag.
entries.icon_hint: a small ornate key with a purple-tinted handle and a faint sparkle, pixel-art icon

open_questions: Exact drop-rate percentages for each reward tier inside a crate's loot table are shown to players on the crate's own tooltip in-game, but were not re-derived here as a static list since they are configuration detail rather than fixed lore.
